title: Understanding OLS
text: The Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) method is used to estimate the parameters in a linear regression model. It minimizes the sum of the squared differences between the observed and predicted values.

title: Number of Parameters vs. Observations
text: In a linear regression model, having more parameters than observations can lead to overfitting and a lack of a unique solution. Consider the relationship between the number of observations and parameters.

title: Unique Solution in OLS
text: For a unique OLS solution, the number of observations should be greater than the number of parameters. This ensures that the matrix used in calculations is invertible.
